title: Rigging, Raw Stock, and Opening Moves

sets.relationshipLabel: the stage that opens the larger span
sets.explanation: A kickoff opens a football season just as a launch opens a voyage — each is the first stage of a longer stretch, in that fixed order.
Hemp and flax are raw fibers spun into rope and twine, the cordage each is worked into.

sets.relationshipLabel: the drawn or cut template and the built thing it produces
sets.explanation: A pattern is cut into a sail just as a blueprint is built into a hull — the template made into the object.

sets.relationshipLabel: a thing that fastens to what holds it
sets.explanation: An anchor fastens via its chain and a cork fastens via its line — the fastener always leads to the thing that secures it, never the reverse.
